title: A source that is client-rendered end to end
why: The served document is an empty `<div id="root">` and a module script; every word, every link and a `<canvas>` are created after load. A fetch-only crawl gets one thin page and cannot reach the second route at all, so this archetype's whole value is that the *capture must say so* rather than producing a replica of an empty div. `--render` is the flag the note has to teach, and it needs a browser — which makes this the one archetype the live tier refuses rather than skips.

notes.match: almost no text with scripts present
notes.means: the crawl recognised a client-rendered page and taught --render instead of reporting a captured site
